_how: Flip outage to true and commit. Every Mimasaur page reads this file within a minute — no Netlify build. The banner clears itself when the provider recovers; set this back to false whenever convenient. Leave message empty for the built-in wording.
_announcement_how: To show a card at the top of every dashboard, replace null with the object below and commit. Live within a minute, no build. Set it back to null (or let 'until' pass) to remove it. A new 'id' shows it again to people who dismissed it.

_announcement_example.text: 💳 Paid plans open on 1 October. Your free trial keeps running until {trial_ends} ({days_left} days left). When you pay, your 30 days are ADDED on top of the days you still have — paying early never loses you a day.

_announcement_fields: text: plain words, may use {trial_ends} {paid_until} {days_left} — the reader's own dates. until: YYYY-MM-DD, hidden after that day (Manila). audience: all (default) · trial · paid. link: a Mimasaur page like plans.html or an https:// address; link_text: the words on it. Both optional.
